other_failure_modes.name: Target Encoding Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Applying target encoding to the training set using the training set's own targets without using out-of-fold (OOF) encoding. This causes severe target leakage, allowing the model to memorize the target values and overfit.

summary: The agent implements a structured LightGBM cross-validation pipeline with some basic feature engineering. However, it introduces a critical target leakage failure by applying target encoding directly on the training folds without out-of-fold calculation, which will cause the model to severely overfit. Additionally, the agent ignores potential temporal ordering by using a randomized split despite the presence of date features.
